CustomField.description: Set by AF_FL_Opp_RequestClosure at submission time to the Opportunity Owner's Manager. Exists purely so the AF_EA_Opp_ApprovalRequested Email Alert has a declarative way to reach a dynamically-resolved recipient (Owner's Manager isn't one of the native Email Alert recipient types) — the Flow only ever sets this field, the actual email send is handled natively by the Email Alert/Email Template, no Apex involved.
CustomField.label: Approval Recipient
